title: Surjective coefficient extension preserves flat sheaves
statement: For an essentially small site $J$, Noetherian commutative rings $A,B$ in the module universe, a surjective ring homomorphism $f:A\twoheadrightarrow B$, and a flat sheaf $F$ of $A$-modules, the scalar extension $E_fF$ of [def-pur-finite-reduction-system] is flat as a sheaf of $B$-modules. Flat means that both categorical tensor functors are exact. No flatness of $B$ over $A$ is required.

source.place: First paragraph: scalar extension on flat models and successive coefficient reductions

proof.text: Reduction modulo ker(f) preserves flatness by the proved Sheaf.flat_quotSMulTop_obj. The flat quotient has locally trivial relations by [lem-sf-fixed-coefficient-flat-local-relations]; transport the locally trivial relations criterion through the ring equivalence A/ker(f) = B.

source.place: First paragraph: scalar extension on flat models and successive coefficient reductions

proof.text: The tensor comparison [lem-pur-finite-reduction-restrict-tensor] identifies the restricted extension with the restricted quotient reduction. Surjectivity makes restriction fully faithful, so lift this isomorphism to B-module sheaves and transport flatness.
